families.name: Room to connect
families.shows: free grid capacity, hosting capacity or connection queues per substation, node or area (Grid capacity layer, site analysis)

families.name: Every generating unit
families.shows: national registers of generating units (layer per country under Power plants)

families.name: Live mix and CO₂
families.shows: generation by source at the operator's own time step, and CO₂ per kWh where the operator publishes it (country cards)

families.name: Redispatch and curtailment
families.shows: redispatch, countertrading, congestion-management costs and curtailment (country cards, agent catalogue)

families.name: Wholesale prices
families.shows: day-ahead and imbalance (or real-time) prices (Prices views, imbalance card)

families.name: What consumers pay
families.shows: household and business electricity and gas prices (retail colouring, country report)

families.name: Emitters per installation
families.shows: verified CO₂ per installation (CO₂ per installation layer)

families.name: Plants offline now
families.shows: generating units out of service now (planned and forced)

families.name: EV charging
families.shows: public charge points (EV charging layer) and counts per country

families.name: Gas
families.shows: gas flows, storage, LNG and prices

families.name: Reliability
families.shows: interruptions per customer (SAIDI, SAIFI) or outages per area
